label: IDN Open Protocol (compatible with NDI®)
detail: An open implementation compatible with NDI® (IDN Open Protocol 0.3.1), compiled into this server: no runtime to install. Its sources appear in the source list of compatible receivers. NDI® is a registered trademark of Vizrt NDI AB; this project is not affiliated with or endorsed by Vizrt.

label: OMT
detail: Open Media Transport (open, royalty-free; vMix, OBS), compiled into this server with its VMX codec: no runtime to install. Its sources appear as "HOST (name)" in OMT receivers. Alpha and program audio are sent.

label: Display
detail: Fullscreen outputs on attached monitors are not supported yet; they will also need a display server (this server runs without one).

label: SDI
detail: SDI cards (DeckLink) are planned for a later version.
